column8: ["The thin teal hoops and flat brown arms read as a sparse diagram rather than one solid, weighty kiln-floor machine.","Across all three seats, the rims lack convincing ceramic glaze or matte rubber, while the brown arms lack the rubbed edges and tonal depth of darkened brass.","The repeated plain rings and featureless arms feel tentative, with little crafted character or contact-edge detail to reward a closer look."]
